prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Sandbox Screen: Add an interactive practice sandbox screen right after home intro where users practice dragging, hiding, and talking to their pet in a mini desktop environment before completing setup.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_sandbox"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Practice Controls"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Reset Warning Callout: Display a prominent warning hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users to log in with their original account to preserve existing pet profiles.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Please sign in with your original account to keep your saved pet profiles and avoid resetting progress."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Interactive Controls Checklist Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive checklist layout that walks users through basic desktop pet controls like hiding, dragging, and tray settings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Master Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Complete these quick steps to learn how to summon, move, and customize your desktop pet."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Live Pet Render Preview Flow: Introduce a live interactive preview component during photo upload and selection so users can see and adjust their custom pet visual rendering before confirming adoption.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "playful", "text": "Live Render Preview: See how your pet will appear on screen"}]}}
4: [home, hint] Desktop Display Diagnostic Check: Show a clear status diagnostic on the waiting screen confirming screen overlay permissions and hardware acceleration support before launching the desktop pet.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Verifying screen overlay permissions and desktop graphics compatibility..."}}
5: [choose_path, redesign] Split Layout Path Selection: Redesign choose_path into a side-by-side split layout comparing preset quick pets versus custom photo pets with immediate feature previews.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Path", "body": "Select a ready-to-play preset pet or upload photos to generate a custom companion."}}
6: [adoption, reorder] Reordered Friend Selection First: Reorder onboarding sequence to present pet selection (pick_friend) right at the beginning before path details.
   config: {"_order": ["pick_friend", "story", "choose_path", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Quick Controls Summary: Update adoption certificate layout to a card format featuring clear desktop shortcut badges and key gesture controls for hiding and interacting with the pet.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Congratulations! Double-click your pet to open options, or right-click to hide to tray."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Interactive Story Mascot Guide: Add an animated mascot guide to the story screen explaining desktop pet abilities with engaging visual badges.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Hi! I am your desktop buddy guide. Let us find your perfect pet!"}]}}
9: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Guide Screen: Add a dedicated controls introduction screen right after home intro showing tray options, visibility toggles, and shortcut keys.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_guide"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Companion!"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a practice sandbox screen after home intro is valid under onboarding customization rules.
Adding a sign-in warning callout to preserve pet profiles does not violate any base rules.
Redesigning the home intro into an interactive controls checklist maintains all required functionality.
Adding a live render preview component during photo upload is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Displaying display diagnostics on the waiting screen keeps the wait screen functionality intact.
Split layout redesign of path selection preserves both adoption and custom pet options.
Reordering pet selection to the beginning of onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Updating adoption certificate to card layout with desktop shortcuts retains the official certificate job.
Adding a mascot guide to the story screen maintains the pet introduction function.
Adding a dedicated controls guide screen after home intro complies with onboarding extension rules.
